request-prompt: Remove the 'Need more help? Post to the help community' section at the bottom to focus purely on the self-service steps in the article.
goal: I prefer to resolve issues independently using self-service help articles and documentation.
jobs: I want to understand why Google is showing me the 'Unusual traffic from your computer network' warning.
I want to find a quick solution to get rid of the error message so I can resume using Google Search.
I want to troubleshoot why the error message keeps reappearing even after I successfully solve the reCAPTCHA.
I want to determine if my VPN, network settings, or malware is causing Google to block my traffic.
I want to learn what actions to take as a network administrator to stop Google from blocking our network's users.
I want to find a way to contact the Google Search Help Community to get further assistance with my specific issue.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer simple, straightforward, and jargon-free instructions when troubleshooting technical issues online.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer detailed, technical explanations and root-cause analyses when troubleshooting technical issues online.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer to resolve issues independently using self-service help articles and documentation.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer to interact with a community of users or direct support agents to solve my technical issues.

preference-pairs.a: I prioritize privacy and security (like using VPNs and strict browser settings) even if it causes browsing friction and errors on websites.
preference-pairs.b: I prioritize convenience and seamless access, preferring to disable any security or privacy tools that interfere with my web browsing.

preference: I prefer to resolve issues independently using self-service help articles and documentation.
